facts.value: Processes KneeBend interrupts in canonical order: ftCo_Attack100_CheckInput, ftCo_Catch_CheckInput, then ftCo_AttackHi4_CheckInputNoD0. The first function actually dispatches ftData_SpecialHi[fp->kind] when non-NULL and fp->x686 == 0, not rapid-jab continuation. Each true result stops processing; only the all-false path performs short-hop release detection. Catch and NoD0 include optional paths, and NoD0 may select an item throw or character-specific attack.
facts.rationale: Corrects the rapid-jab interpretation using actual dispatch and preserves exact local priority.

evidence.why: Ordered early returns and final release-helper call.
Preliminary handling and guarded Catch entry.

facts.value: Forwards the same Fighter_GObj* through ftCo_Attack100_CheckInput (guarded SpecialHi table dispatch), ftCo_Catch_CheckInput and ftCo_AttackHi4_CheckInputNoD0 until one returns true. Only if all return false does it pass the object to ftCo_KneeBend_Check_ShortHop, which reads controller state, the stored jump source and common release threshold and may assign true to kneebend.is_short_hop. No object pointer is retained locally.
facts.rationale: Preserves established object flow while distinguishing a handling result from independently verified transition success.

evidence.why: True follows a void per-kind dispatch.

facts.value: The canonical Attack100 predicate, actually guarded SpecialHi dispatch, has first priority, followed by Catch and NoD0 AttackHi4. Each true result immediately returns, suppressing lower-priority checks and release processing for that invocation. Only all-false execution reaches release latching. This TU initializes the latch false in Enter and otherwise only writes true; global move-state lifetime and every dispatched handler's transition are not established by that local invariant.
facts.rationale: Corrects first-check meaning and bounds lifetime and success claims to observed control flow.

facts.value: Sets kneebend.is_short_hop true when a source-matched release condition succeeds: XY with neither X nor Y held, LStick with left-stick Y strictly below tap_jump_release_threshold, or CStick with C-stick Y strictly below that threshold. Otherwise preserves the field. Equality and unordered NaN comparisons do not count as stick release, and unsupported source values match no branch. Live-input tests precede their source-equality tests in the expression. The helper never clears the flag or validates the active state. Enter supplies this TU's false initialization; external states also reuse the helper.
facts.rationale: Replaces global exclusive-reset wording with exact local writes, boundaries and evaluation convention.

facts.value: Enter stores the jump source, clears the short-hop flag and requests KneeBend with animation start/speed/blend 0,1,0. IASA prioritizes canonical ftCo_Attack100_CheckInput (actually guarded SpecialHi dispatch), then Catch, then NoD0 AttackHi4; only all-false execution performs release latching. Anim completes when cur_anim_frame >= jump_startup_time or no animation frames remain, selecting ItemScrew for held It_Kind_ScBall and ordinary Jump otherwise. Phys delegates ground friction/movement. Coll delegates position synchronization and a Fall transition guarded by the exact GA_Ground comparison. The TU only writes true to the latch after entry; compiled cross-state handoff and physical collision-result polarity remain unresolved.
facts.rationale: Consolidates corrected interrupt semantics, exact completion and item conditions, and scoped uncertainty.
